svg.aria-label: Three bighorn and thinhorn ram horn tests, each with a ram head seen square from the side, a legal ram on the left and a not legal ram on the right. Full curl bighorn ram: the line runs from the centre of the nostril to the lowest back edge of the horn base; legal when a horn tip rises above the line, not legal when the tip stays below it. 3/4 curl bighorn ram: a second line runs through the back of the eye, at right angles to line 1; legal when the tip is forward of that line, not legal when it is still behind it. Full curl thinhorn ram and mature bighorn ram: the line runs along the bridge of the nose, extended; legal when the tip rises above the nose line, not legal when it stays below.
svg.text: Tip above nostril to horn base line
Tip past the eye line, square to line 1
Tip above the nose bridge line
